arguments.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a boiler can mean a gas leak, so please treat this as urgent, even though it's late. Please: 1) turn the boiler off and don't use it, 2) don't use switches, flames or lighters, 3) open the windows and get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum, 4) call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If anyone feels dizzy, sick or unwell, or you're in immediate danger, call 999. We're arranging a Gas Safe engineer and will update you. Please don't go back in until you're told it's safe.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, a rotten-egg smell from a boiler can mean a gas leak, so please treat this as urgent, even though it's late. Please: 1) turn the boiler off and don't use it, 2) don't use switches, flames or lighters, 3) open the windows and get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum, 4) call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours) from outside. If anyone feels dizzy, sick or unwell, or you're in immediate danger, call 999. We're arranging a Gas Safe engineer and will update you. Please don't go back in until you're told it's safe.
